clauses.title: Scope – Requirements regarding materials,
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements regarding materials, manufactre, finihs. ,marking and packing of parliament hinges.

clauses.title: Types
clauses.text: 2. Types Type 1 Cast (Cast brass) Type 2 Pressed (Mildsteel, Alluminium alloy) Type 3 Fabricated (Extruted Alluminium alloy) Note— Materials for different types are given above within brackets. For requirements of materials, see Table 1 of the standard.

clauses.title: Alluminium
clauses.text: 3.1 Alluminium  Alloy Parliament Hinges — 50, 65, 75, 100, 125, 150, 175, and  200 mm. For  tolerances see Table 2 of the standard.

clauses.title: Cast Brass Parliament Hinges
clauses.text: 3.2 Cast Brass Parliament Hinges — 50, 65, 75, 100, 125, 150, 175 and 200 mm. For tolerances see Table 3 of the standard.

clauses.title: Mild Steel Parliament Hinges
clauses.text: 3.3 Mild Steel Parliament Hinges —50, 65, 75, 100, 125, 150, 175 and 200 mm. For tolerances see Table 4 of the standard

clauses.title: Manufacture – Hinges shall
clauses.text: 4. Manufacture - Hinges shall be well made and be free from flaws and defects of all kinds. Washer shall be provided between knuckles for Type 1 and Type 3 hinges. Washer shall be made of nylon, plastic or any other suitable material. In locations susceptible to corrosion, use of brass or phosphor bronze hinge pins is recommended in case of brass hinges. All screw holes shall be clean and counter sunk.

clauses.title: Finish
clauses.text: 5. Finish—Brass parliament hinges shall  have either bright or satin finish and shall be suitably protected against discoloration.

clauses.title: Aluminium alloy hinges shall be anodized
clauses.text: 5.1 Aluminium alloy hinges shall be anodized  to a bright, natural, mat or satin finish or dyed.

clauses.title: Mild steel parliament hinges
clauses.text: 5.2  Mild steel parliament hinges shall be finished bright or electro-galvanized as specified by the purchaser. For detailed information, refer to IS  362 : 1991 Specification for parliament hinges (fourth revision). SUMMARY OF IS 362 : 1991 PARLIAMENT HINGES (Fifth Revision)
